In [[mathematics]], a '''Petersson algebra''' is a [[composition algebra]] over a [[field (mathematics)|field]] constructed from an order-3 [[automorphism]] of a [[Hurwitz algebra]]. They were first constructed by {{harvtxt|Petersson|1969}}.

== Construction ==

Suppose that ''C'' is a Hurwitz algebra and ''φ'' is an automorphism of order 3. Define the new product of ''x'' and ''y'' to be ''φ''({{overline|''x''}})''φ''<sup>2</sup>({{overline|''y''}}). With this new product the algebra is called a Petersson algebra.
